## 说明

该函数返回FAO为四个区域发布的按分区（FAO主要渔区内的组成部分）统计的捕捞产量，格式同`load_fao_data()`，另外多三列：`Division`（代码，例如"37.1.1"）、`Division..Name.`（代码和名称，例如"37.1.1 Balearic"）和`Region`。它可以在`by = "division"`时传给`pelagic_demersal()`和`mean_temperature_catch()`，也可以作为渔获数据用于任何其他分析。

- **GFCM**：地中海渔业总委员会（General Fisheries Commission for the Mediterranean），37渔区（地中海和黑海），分区如37.1.1巴利阿里、37.2.1亚得里亚海、37.4.2黑海。
- **CECAF**：中东大西洋渔业委员会（Fishery Committee for the Eastern Central Atlantic），34渔区。
- **SEATL**：东南大西洋（Southeast Atlantic），47渔区。
- **RECOFI**：区域渔业委员会（Regional Commission for Fisheries），51渔区的一部分（海湾、阿曼海和阿拉伯海西南部）。

在2026.1.0版本中，GFCM和CECAF的数据始于1970年，SEATL始于1975年，RECOFI始于1986年。有些代码并不对应具体海域："Tunas"（例如34.0.0，按整个渔区报告的金枪鱼）和"Not known"（例如37.9.0；34.1.9则表示亚区已知而分区不明）。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function returns the capture production by division (parts of an FAO major fishing area)
that FAO publishes for four regions, in the format of `load_fao_data()` with three more columns:
`Division` (code, e.g. "37.1.1"), `Division..Name.` (code and name, e.g. "37.1.1 Balearic") and
`Region`. It can be given to `pelagic_demersal()` and `mean_temperature_catch()` with
`by = "division"`, or to any other analysis as catch data.

- **GFCM**: General Fisheries Commission for the Mediterranean: area 37 (Mediterranean and Black Sea), divisions such as 37.1.1 Balearic, 37.2.1 Adriatic, 37.4.2 Black Sea.
- **CECAF**: Fishery Committee for the Eastern Central Atlantic: area 34.
- **SEATL**: Southeast Atlantic: area 47.
- **RECOFI**: Regional Commission for Fisheries: part of area 51 (the Gulf, the Sea of Oman and the southwestern Arabian Sea).

In release 2026.1.0, GFCM and CECAF start in 1970, SEATL in 1975 and RECOFI in 1986. Some codes
are not places: "Tunas" (e.g. 34.0.0, tunas reported for the whole area) and "Not known"
(e.g. 37.9.0, or 34.1.9 for a subarea whose division is not known).

</details>

## 用法

```r
load_fao_divisions(
  region = NULL,
  version = "latest",
  data_dir = fao_data_dir()
)
```

## 参数

`region`
:   要读取的区域："GFCM"、"CECAF"、"SEATL"和"RECOFI"中的任意几个。默认为NULL，即全部区域。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The regions: any of "GFCM", "CECAF", "SEATL" and "RECOFI". Default is NULL, all.

    </details>

`version`
:   所用的版本，如"2026.1.0"。默认为"latest"（最新版本）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The release, e.g. "2026.1.0". Default is "latest".

    </details>

`data_dir`
:   数据的保存目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The directory where the data is saved. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.

    </details>

## 返回值

一个数据框，包含`load_fao_data()`的各列以及`Division`、`Division..Name.`和`Region`，并带有属性`fao_version`和`source_url`。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

A data frame with the columns of `load_fao_data()` and `Division`, `Division..Name.`
and `Region`, with the attributes `fao_version` and `source_url`.

</details>

## 详细说明

GFCM、CECAF和SEATL的分区覆盖整个FAO渔区：在两个数据集中都有的记录里，几乎所有记录按分区加总后，某一国家、物种和年份的渔获量都与`load_fao_data()`中该渔区的渔获量相同（2026.1.0版本中，99.7%至100%的记录相差在1%以内）；只出现在其中一个数据集中的记录合计不到渔获量的2.2%。RECOFI只覆盖海湾、阿曼海和阿拉伯海西南部，即51渔区的一部分。

数据来自FAO数据索引（<https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/Data/>）中的FI_Regional文件。联网时使用最新版本：第一次使用时下载（约5 MB）并转换，保存在`data_dir`中；离线时，或设置了`fao_settings(online = FALSE)`时，使用已保存的最新版本。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

The divisions of GFCM, CECAF and SEATL cover the whole FAO area: summed over the divisions, the
catch of a country, species and year equals that of the area in `load_fao_data()` for nearly
all records found in both (99.7 to 100% within 1% in release 2026.1.0), and the records found
in one dataset only hold less than 2.2% of the catch. RECOFI covers only the Gulf, the Sea of
Oman and the southwestern Arabian Sea, a part of area 51.

The data come from the file FI_Regional of the FAO data index
(<https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/Data/>). When the computer is online, the newest
release is used, downloaded and converted the first time (about 5 MB) and saved in `data_dir`;
offline, or with `fao_settings(online = FALSE)`, the newest saved release is used.

</details>

## 参考文献

FAO. Fishery and Aquaculture Statistics: capture production by regional fishery bodies
(FI_Regional). <https://www.fao.org/fishery/statistics-query/en>

## 示例

```r
med <- load_fao_divisions("GFCM")
pelagic_demersal(med, by = "division")
mean_temperature_catch(med, by = "division")
```
